title: Add notification badge overlay to workspace favicons
description:
Add red dot notification badge overlay to workspace favicons when unread messages exist.

**Goal:** Keep workspace icon identification (current behavior) AND show notification state (new feature).

**Approach:** Canvas-based dynamic composition
1. Fetch workspace icon via background script (CORS bypass)
2. Pre-compose two favicon variants: normal + with red dot badge
3. Detect unread state from Slack's favicon URL changes
4. Switch between cached variants based on unread state

**Success Criteria:**
- Workspace icons display correctly (existing behavior preserved)
- Red dot badge appears when ANY unread messages exist
- Red dot disappears when all messages read
- User can toggle badge visibility in settings
- No CORS errors in console
- No performance degradation

**Testing Checklist:**
- [ ] Extension disabled: default Slack favicon works normally
- [ ] Extension enabled, no unread: workspace icon shown (no badge)
- [ ] Extension enabled, unread messages: workspace icon + red dot
- [ ] Messages read: red dot disappears
- [ ] Settings toggle: showDot off hides badge even with unread
- [ ] Workspace switch: new workspace icon loads correctly
- [ ] Multiple Slack tabs: each shows correct workspace icon

title: Phase 1: Background Script CORS Helper
description:
Add CORS bypass mechanism to background.js for fetching workspace icons.

**Why needed:** Content scripts cannot fetch cross-origin images and use them in canvas.toDataURL() due to CORS restrictions. Service workers (background scripts) have no such restrictions.

**Components:**
- fetchIcon message handler: receives URL, fetches via fetch(), returns base64 data URL
- blobToDataURL helper: converts fetch blob to data URL using FileReader

**Message format:**
- Request: {action: 'fetchIcon', url: 'https://...'}
- Response: {success: true, dataUrl: 'data:image/png;base64,...'}

**File:** js/background.js

title: Step 1.1: Add fetchIcon message handler
description:
Handle {action: 'fetchIcon', url: '...'} messages in background.js.

**Implementation:**
```javascript
if (message.action === "fetchIcon") {
    fetch(message.url)
        .then(response => response.blob())
        .then(blob => blobToDataURL(blob))
        .then(dataUrl => sendResponse({success: true, dataUrl}))
        .catch(err => sendResponse({success: false, error: err.message}));
    return true; // async response
}
```

**File:** js/background.js

**Verify:** Test by sending message from console: `chrome.runtime.sendMessage({action: 'fetchIcon', url: 'https://example.com/icon.png'})` - confirm data URL returned.

Phase 2: Canvas Composer Module
description:
Create Canvas-based favicon composition system.

**Purpose:** Dynamically compose workspace icon with optional red dot notification badge overlay.

**Approach:**
1. Create 32x32 offscreen canvas
2. Draw workspace icon scaled to fill
3. If showBadge: draw red circle (#E01E5A) at top-right (26,6) with radius 6px
4. Add 1px white stroke for visibility on dark icons
5. Export as PNG data URL

**Output:** Promise resolving to 'data:image/png;base64,...'

**File:** js/content.js

Phase 3: Icon Fetching and Caching
description:
Implement icon fetching via background script and caching system.

**Cache structure:**
```javascript
iconCache = {
    teamIconDataUrl: null,   // Original workspace icon as data URL
    normalFavicon: null,      // Pre-composed without badge
    unreadFavicon: null       // Pre-composed with red dot
}
```

**Benefits of pre-composition:**
- Instant favicon switching when unread state changes
- No runtime canvas operations during state transitions
- Single fetch per workspace, cached for session

**File:** js/content.js


Phase 4: Unread Detection Integration
description:
Integrate unread message detection with favicon updates.

**Detection method:** Check if Slack's favicon href contains 'unread' substring.
- favicon-32.png → no unread messages
- favicon-unread-32.png → unread messages exist

**State tracking:** Module-level hasUnread boolean, updated in MutationObserver callback.

**Favicon application:** When state changes, immediately apply cached iconCache.unreadFavicon or iconCache.normalFavicon.

**File:** js/content.js (modify existing MutationObserver)

Phase 6: Edge Cases and Error Handling
description:
Handle edge cases and failure scenarios gracefully.

**Scenarios covered:**
1. Missing .c-team_icon element → fall back to default Slack favicon
2. Background fetch fails → use direct URL (badge won't work but icon shows)
3. Element not ready on page load → retry with exponential backoff
4. Workspace switching in SPA → detect URL change, invalidate cache, re-fetch

**Principle:** Extension should never break Slack's normal operation, even on errors.

**Files:** js/content.js
